criteria.family: TECH; painted volumetric objects, not PM pictograms
criteria.dominant_subject: One apparatus or firing assembly, no more than one supporting accessory
criteria.colors: Natural lead grey, timber brown, brick terracotta, fireclay buff and ivory-white bowl. No global blue cast.
criteria.alpha: Genuine exterior transparency; dark cavities remain physical object interiors. Furnace V1 background corrected by imagegen V2.
criteria.small_sizes: Silhouettes and major material distinctions reviewed at 32/48/64 px on light and dark neutral backgrounds.
criteria.native_references: Compared with three installed vanilla technology textures, not used as generated new assets.
criteria.crop: No cropping; transparent canvas extension preserves all source RGBA pixels exactly.
criteria.gameplay: No new lot DDS, definition, gameplay, costs, unlocks, copper chain or laboratory PM edits.

per_asset.assessment: Sheet-metal chamber and subordinate receiver read distinctly; sulphur tray is an interior component. Cutaway is a stylized visual explanation, not an operating plant reconstruction.
Low stationary brick furnace, separate firebox and white ash tray visible. Warm illumination is confined inside furnace. Corrected V2 exterior has no brown halo.
Thick rough fireclay cassette and single smooth ivory bowl have distinct coherent nested forms. The bowl remains legible at small size.

limitations: Static visual and file checks only. Not an in-engine rendering test.
New lot requires explicit user approval before DDS export or texture binding.
